parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the WAF instance. Valid values:

*   **cn-hangzhou**: Chinese mainland
*   **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi create-postpaid-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm4gh0000wela --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
